crop.notes: Sporting Notes column; only the first item is about Allen. The others concern a German wolf dog, the Brighton Beach track sale and a checkers match.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat's Sporting Notes carried a notice for Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening with only the best singers.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, March 26, 1892, page 7. Same notice as article 841.

facts.fact: Allen's saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, advertised a free concert every evening

notes: Repeat of the notice in article 841.
